description: Get a document e-signed instead of printed. Nothing is sent to anyone: this hands the markdown to md2sign (same company) and returns a link your human opens to sign up or log in, where the document waits as a draft ready to send. The link works once and expires after 24 hours; md2sign keeps the document until then. Also returns how to connect md2sign's own MCP server so you can send it directly. Use when the document has signature lines and your human wants it signed.

markdown.description: The full markdown document, with a [[signature: Name <email>]] line for each signer.

name: send_for_signature
title: Send for e-signature with md2sign
